Solution 2 is the most plausible. Solution 1's constants don't follow from its own inequalities, and Solution 3 uses a different algorithm and its "tightness" claim is unsupported. Solution 2's bound $\lambda < 1/(2L)$ matches the standard step-size condition for Popov's (past-extragradient) method with a single operator evaluation per iteration. I did not verify the tightness claim for the pseudo-monotone case independently, so this rests on the standard literature bound rather than a full derivation.

CHOICE: 2
